decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal would involve the merging of a 3-bedroom family sized flat with a one-bedroom non-family sized flat. As it would not involve the combination of separate non-family sized flats and given that the total floorspace of the new dwelling would exceed 130sq.m, the proposal would not satisfy criterion 1 of policy LP25. The proposal would therefore result in harm to the supply and choice of housing within the borough and fails to comply with policy H8 of the London Plan (2021) and policy LP25 of Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 2 - The proposed development would result in the replacement of traditional sash windows with inappropriate, highly visible, contemporary doors and the loss of the existing boundary walls and railings that make a positive contribution to the character and appearance of the conservation area. Accordingly, the development would result in less than substantial harm to the character and appearance of the locally listed building and Wandsworth Common Conservation Area. The harm would not be outweighed by public benefits. The proposal is therefore contrary to the NPPF (2024), policy HC1 (C) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP1, LP3, LP5 and LP6 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 3 - The proposed two-storey extensions by reason of their design, scale and location would be an unneighbourly form of development that would have a detrimental impact on the amenity of neighbouring properties in the form of loss outlook, being overbearing and creating an increased sense of enclosure as well as actual and perceived loss of privacy and overlooking. The proposal has also failed to demonstrate that there would not be unacceptable harm to neighbouring windows in respect to reductions in daylight and sunlight. The proposal is therefore contrary to policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 4 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to make available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
description:
Alterations including a stepped, two-storey side extension, altered fenestration including rooflights with associated alterations and internal reconfiguration. 
Amalgamation of two flats (a one-bedroom basement flat and three bedroom maisonette) to create one family dwelling.
